definitions.explanation: Formally asking for something that is owed or due.
A request for payment for goods or services.

notes:
{請求|せいきゅう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ is used as a ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧-verb meaning "to claim" or "to request."

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {請求|せいきゅう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to claim, to demand, to bill)
- ⟦{請求|せいきゅう}{書|しょ}→請求書：04698_seikyuusho⟧ (invoice, bill)
- {請求|せいきゅう}⟦{額|がく}→額：02607_gaku⟧ (amount claimed, billed amount)
- ⟦{損害|そんがい}→損害：02615_songai⟧⟦{賠償|ばいしょう}→賠償：07641_baishou⟧{請求|せいきゅう} (claim for damages)
- ⟦{保険|ほけん}→保険：01509_hoken⟧{請求|せいきゅう} (insurance claim)
- ⟦{過払|かば}い{金|きん}→過払い金：noentry⟧{請求|せいきゅう} (claim for overpayment refund)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {請求|せいきゅう}: claim, demand (formal, legal context)
- ⟦{要求|ようきゅう}→要求：03658_youkyuu⟧: demand, request (more forceful)
- ⟦{要請|ようせい}→要請：05463_yousei⟧: request (polite, official)
